merge.title: FSBL pre-freeze FI bundle: fail-closed gate polarity + default-poisoned, redundantly-encoded branch target; minimal TRNG for wait_random; 0xFF tail scan; MSPLIM; #591 sweep as acceptance test (C10 target-sum internals staged behind the sweep)
merge.threat: Voltage/EM/laser fault injection against the one stage that becomes unpatchable at WRP+RDP-2 (invariant #10). Concretely, in the linked bench FSBL ELF (target/fsbl/thumbv8m.main-none-eabi/release/pqsigner-fsbl, built 2026-09-29, fsbl/src unchanged since c6a97080): (1) the signature gate's caller glue is fail-OPEN on a single instruction skip — `bl check_true_into_sentinel; cmp r0,#0xA5A5A5A5; bne <reject>` at 0x0c000e5a/0x0c000e5e, accept is the fall-through, and nothing re-checks the verdict later; (2) the chosen slot lives as a plain word at [sp,#8] across tz-1 and the 4 s fingerprint hold and `into_slot` treats ANY non-zero value as slot B (`cmp r0,#0; it ne; addne r1,#0x74000`, 0x0c00192a-0x0c00193a), so one data fault boots the other slot while the panel shows the verified slot's fingerprint; (3) every FI delay is the constant 0x42 (fsbl/src/fi.rs:31-33; `movs r0,#66` at 0x0c000846), so the two evaluations inside check_true_into_sentinel sit at a fixed, offline-characterisable offset; (4) verify_images hashes only secure_len/ns_len bytes (fsbl/src/verify.rs:38-108), leaving up to the slot capacity of executable secure flash unmeasured and outside the fingerprint; (5) no MSPLIM (fsbl/src/main.rs:172, manifest.rs:30). The C10-specific fault class is a skipped target-sum constraint at sphincs-c10/src/wots.rs:178 (C10 is WOTS+C: there are NO checksum chains — the members' 'WOTS checksum' wording is wrong); Wagner et al. eprint 2023/1572 and AISEC/BSI eprint 2025/2096 establish that this class applies to verification.
merge.proposal:
ONE FSBL-only change set, landed and re-frozen before the WRP/RDP-2 ceremony, plus one conditional shared-crate follow-up.

STAGE A (freeze-gating, pure fsbl/, no flash/OTP/option-byte write path added):
A1. Fail-closed admission + default-poisoned target. Replace the `Option<(Slot,[u8;32])>` / let-else flow (fsbl/src/main.rs:220-222, :367-414) with (i) a volatile `next_stage` word initialised to a poison/halt-stub value and written only as the last statement after filter_valid + verify_images + tz-1 + render (Trezor boardloader main.c:250-279, 356-369); (ii) per-stage Hamming-distant verdict words (manifest_ok, images_ok, optbytes_ok, render_ok) that are ACCUMULATED and folded arithmetically into the target address (e.g. addr ^ (acc ^ EXPECTED)) so a skipped `bne` yields a non-slot address instead of an accept — this is the fix for the single-skip in live_defects[0]; branch polarity alone is compiler-dependent, the arithmetic binding is not; (iii) Slot carried as a Hamming-distant u32 plus complement copy, re-compared after tz-1 and again immediately before the branch (Trezor bootloader main.c:593-595, 630-632, 693-701 is a REPEATED compare across the flow, not three back-to-back), and `into_slot` must reject anything that is not exactly one of the two encodings (today non-zero == B). A jump to 0 with TZEN=1 is a SecureFault, not a reset entry — use an explicit halt stub.
A2. Minimal TRNG for wait_random: HSI48 on with a BOUNDED ready wait (fsbl/src/clock.rs discipline; #642 pattern), RCC CCIPR RNGSEL + AHB2ENR1 bit 18 (secure/src/hw/rcc.rs:141-148), GTZC RNGSEC set the way fsbl/src/hash.rs:49-66 sets HASHSEC (securable peripherals reset non-secure), AN4230 CR/HTCR/NSCR inside the CONDRST window (secure/src/hw/rng.rs:493-515; the #698 seed-error trap), bounded conditioning-reset retries, SR error flags only. Do NOT copy secure/src/hw/rng.rs (36,374 B of source), do NOT add software health tests or a KAT, do NOT set CONFIGLOCK (rng.rs:42-57: it would shadow the secure world's later config), and RCC-reset the RNG before handoff. Jitter only — never key material, so #704 does not gate it. Failure policy = halt (recoverable by power-cycle, no latch), per owner decision in #834; needs an explicit owner acknowledgement that a persistently dead HSI48/TRNG is then a permanent no-boot.
A3. One wait_random() BEFORE each check_true_into_sentinel and before the branch (Trezor fih_delay precedes every ensure, boardloader main.c:114-129). Today v1 of every gate sits at a deterministic offset from reset; the in-gate waits only retime v2.
A4. Tail scan: after hashing, require 0xFF (only 0xFF — the updater erases whole slots, secure/src/hw/flash.rs:1366-1386) over secure_len..SLOT_SECURE_CAPACITY and ns_len..SLOT_NS_CAPACITY (fw-manifest/src/lib.rs:177,180), read-only, word-wise (Trezor image.c:441-522). Bound must come from the geometry registry: the Route1 journals planned at pages 64/122 (#758) sit in the slot tail and must be excluded when #540 lands.
A5. MSPLIM: `msr MSPLIM` to RAM origin + guard at entry, cleared in the handoff asm before `bx` (Trezor startup_init.c:331-336; trezor-comparison.md §8.3 Pattern 1 recommended it, only the register scrub shipped as #489). Overflow becomes HardFault -> default loop = fail-closed.
A6. Acceptance test = #591, widened: tools/sca/fsbl_verify_target + fault_sweep_fsbl_verify.py over the RELEASE FSBL code for filter_valid, verify_images, the post-pick main glue and into_slot, with skip / stuck-at-0 / stuck-at-FF on instructions AND on the slot word; run it FIRST on today's tree to reproduce the single-skip, then on the fix. Extend fault_sweep_c10v.py to cover the target-sum instruction window (today it sweeps only the first 8,000 instructions for that vector, tools/sca/README.md:1842-1848). This replaces BOOT-02's 'disassemble and assert' CI gate: #777 documents why static call-site counting is unsound under the MachineOutliner.

STAGE B (conditional, shared sphincs-c10 crate): only if A6's widened c10v sweep shows a residual single-fault forge inside one verify pass, add an independent second digit extraction + sum and route `sum == TARGET_SUM` through a sentinel in wots::pk_from_sig. It moves the Aeneas/Lean extraction pins (wots.rs comment at :171-174) and needs the SPHINCsC10Asm.sol differential re-run, so it is a separate reviewed change.

BUDGET (measured read-only with scripts/check_fsbl_geometry.py on the existing ELF): physical span 20,972 B, pages 0..2, 11,796 B free in the 32,768 B legacy region, 3,604 B before the page-3 boundary, 17,940 B under FSBL_MAX_LOAD_SPAN 38,912 (geometry/src/lib.rs:49); stack frame sum 8,864 B of 16,376 B (52 frames, largest 6,096 B). My estimate for Stage A is 0.9-1.4 KB (TRNG 350-600, verdict/target/slot encoding 150-250, tail scan 150-250, pre-delays ~40, MSPLIM ~24) — unmeasured, but under 3,604 B, so the derived WRP range stays pages 0..2. No extra stack (nothing nests under the 6,096 B verify frame). Boot cost: no second verify is added (it already runs twice); tail scan of ~600 KB word-wise at HSI16 is on the order of 60-80 ms, TRNG bring-up a few ms — both estimates, to be confirmed with stage-marker.

'Compare the two recomputed roots under ct_eq' (FI-03 #5, FWU-2 b): sphincs_c10::verify returns bool, so this needs a new verify_root API that moves the Aeneas/Lean extraction surface; the values are public so ct_eq buys nothing and fsbl/src/verify.rs:84-86 deliberately keeps `subtle` out of the FSBL.

sigmask/sigmask_inv step mask (FI-03 #5): Trezor's mask tracks WHICH of several keys signed (boot_header.c:56-102); pq1 has one vendor key, so the useful part is subsumed by the accumulated verdict words in A1.

Checksum redundancy 'and in the signer' (BOOT-02 e): signer already does double-compute -> byte-compare -> verify-before-release (CLAUDE.md conventions; crypto::c10_sign_verified*); out of FSBL scope.

FORS forced-zero check through a sentinel (FWU-2 a): hypertree.rs:379-381 is a grinding constraint; skipping it does not by itself yield a forgery, and both passes still need it skipped. Not worth frozen-crate churn.

Option-byte-mismatch escalation via TAMP BKP register / SRAM mailbox to a page-125 dual-SE wipe (SYS-02 #5): (i) the FSBL halts on the tripped boot so the secure world never runs to read it; (ii) with no battery the attacker who is already glitching the option-byte load controls power and can drain the supercap/SRAM, and BKP0..7 are owned by the BHK latch; (iii) it adds TAMP/PWR backup-domain driver code to the frozen range; (iv) it contradicts the recorded tz-1 decision 'fail-only tripwire ... a transient read fault must not brick a good device' (fw-rollback-draft12-candidate-2026-07-21.md:397-407, fsbl/src/optbytes.rs:31-40) and the #705 'deliberately NOT a latch' policy (fsbl/src/main.rs:270-275); (v) Trezor's precedent erases directly from a boardloader that has a flash writer (boardloader main.c:325-335) — the mailbox variant has no precedent.

Copying secure/src/hw/rng.rs plus zero/repeat software tests into the FSBL (SYS-02 #1): 36 KB of source with health-test receipts in an unpatchable stage for a jitter-only consumer; replaced by the minimal sequence in A2.

'TRNG seed error must degrade to a bounded fallback' (SYS-02 risk text): against the owner decision in #834 ('if the RNG fails, we shouldn't fallback. It should error out'); a constant fallback is exactly today's weakness. Halt after bounded conditioning-reset retries instead.
MSPLIM in the secure and NS images (SYS-02 #4, deferred by it to SYS-03): not part of the frozen range; belongs to OPEN-RAM-1 (#542) / #374.
'Triple redundant compare immediately before the branch' (FI-03 #3): misreads Trezor, which repeats one compare at three points of main (593-595, 630-632, 693-701).
'Uniform 0xFF/0x00 fill' (FI-03 #4): pq1 slots are always erased before programming and padded 0xFF, so accepting 0x00 only widens what an attacker may place.
'A skipped check branches to 0 (reset vector)' (FI-03 #2, SYS-02 #2): with TZEN=1 address 0 is the NS alias; a secure-state branch there faults. Still fail-closed, but use an explicit halt stub.

merge.rationale: Four independent surfaces converged on the same pre-freeze window, and the one part none of them stated precisely turned out to be the strongest: disassembling the linked FSBL shows the signature gate accepts on a single skipped `bne`, and the slot selector is an un-encoded stack word held for 4+ seconds. Everything else in the members is either Trezor parity that is confirmed absent (TRNG delay, poisoned target, tail scan, MSPLIM) or already present under a wrong description (the second verify). P1, not P0: nothing ships, the release FSBL cannot even be built, and the freeze waits on other gates — but it is a hard gate on the WRP/RDP-2 ceremony because after it the code can never change. Novelty is parity (Trezor ships A1-A5); only conditional Stage B goes beyond any vendor. Cost M for Stage A (about 1 KB, one sweep harness, one silicon pass); Stage B would add the FV re-pin work.

live_defects.what: Signature admission is fail-open on ONE instruction skip in the linked FSBL: after the double-evaluated C10 verify, the caller does `cmp r0,#0xA5A5A5A5; bne <reject>` with accept as the fall-through, and no later stage re-checks the verdict. Skipping the 16-bit `bne` admits a manifest with an invalid signature (structural, CRC, digest and fingerprint checks are satisfiable without the key; the image-hash gate then passes naturally because the attacker wrote the hashes). The fi.rs header's '2 coordinated faults' bar is therefore not what the binary implements.
live_defects.evidence: Disassembly of /home/nicola/repos/PQSigner_OS/target/fsbl/thumbv8m.main-none-eabi/release/pqsigner-fsbl: 0x0c000e54 `bl check_true_into_sentinel<filter_valid::{closure#2}>`, 0x0c000e58 `movs r5,#0`, 0x0c000e5a `cmp.w r0,#0xa5a5a5a5`, 0x0c000e5e `bne.n 0x0c000ddc` (return None), fall-through to scrub + rollback gate + `it eq; moveq r5,r4`. Source: fsbl/src/main.rs:343-348. Claim it contradicts: fsbl/src/fi.rs:12-16.
live_defects.reachable_in_production_config: The code path is unconditional in every FSBL build (no feature gates it). Exploitation needs attacker-chosen bytes in a slot + manifest page (SWD while the unit is still RDP-0, or a secure-world flash-write primitive after RDP-2) plus one timed skip. Observed on a bench ELF only: `make fsbl-release` is blocked, the emulated sweep (#591) has not been run on this glue, and silicon feasibility is unmeasured.
live_defects.severity: high (in the instruction-skip model; needs-silicon for feasibility)

live_defects.what: Branch target is not bound to the verified slot: `slot` is a 2-variant enum spilled to the stack, held across tz-1 and the 4 s fingerprint hold, reloaded once and decoded as 'non-zero => slot B'. There is no default-fail target and no re-check before the jump.

Until Stage B lands, a skipped target-sum check in both passes remains a theoretical forgery route against a global vendor key. tz-1 stays single-fault-suppressible by design and still ignores WRP1A/OEM locks until #46. A later fake fingerprint screen from updated firmware remains the accepted invariant-#10 residual, and on pq1 the real fingerprint is still invisible on a sealed unit until #705. The TRNG driver, HSI48 dependence and the tail-scan rule become permanent: a bug or a marginal oscillator there is an unfixable no-boot, and any future layout that puts data in a slot tail must be known before the freeze. None of this addresses a stolen vendor key, a tampered FSBL flashed before the user's RDP-0 verification, RDP-2 regression itself (#401), or anything in the patchable secure world (#633). All fault-feasibility statements remain emulation-level until the bench campaign runs.

What is new is only that fsbl/src/fi.rs:12-16 overstates the bar and that no issue tracks it.

The panel also shows the attacker image's true fingerprint. Defect 2 needs no flash write: the previous validly signed image normally sits in the other slot, so one data fault gives a thief a downgrade boot with a lying screen.

Only a working OTP rollback floor stops that, and the floor backend is the unimplemented blocker.
- **A1(ii)'s example fold can cancel.** OK^FAIL is 0xFFFFFFFF, so two failed verdicts XOR back to the expected value unless each stage has distinct constants and a non-cancelling accumulator.
- **A4's bounds are from the legacy layout.** The frozen registry moves slot bases and sizes (secure 57 pages, NS 61 pages, geometry/src/lib.rs:51-53, 121-138). A tail scan frozen with the fw-manifest capacities would reject every image after the #540 cutover.
